text:
sara.ml: quick sync on quant profile packaging for Redwood Optimize — sketching a `qprof` bundle that the optimizer can consume and recommend. thinking the bundle should include: model_id, quant_method (FP8|INT8|GPTQ|AWQ), semantic version, eval_deltas against a pinned baseline, target seq_lens, perf knobs, and compatibility hints. open to naming + fallback rules.

omar: +1. can we also capture the exact kernel variants required (e.g. `fused-gemm-v2`, `awq-kernel-64`) so deploy can pick the right runtime?

liz.pm: product note — Optimize UI needs to show a single recommended profile per deployment preset (latency/high-throughput/cost). also show the eval delta and an explanation tooltip. can we standardize the "deploy_profile" strings?

ben.quant: experiment notes from last week: AWQ on llama-13b: avg MMLU delta ~ -0.9% (vs float), latency down ~35% at seq=128. GPTQ: delta ~ -0.3%, latency down ~20%. FP8 prototypes are noisy across seeds, not ready to recommend as default.

kai.eng: proposal for naming: `qprof:<model>@<quant>-v<semver>` e.g. `qprof:meta-llama-2-13b@awq-v1.2.0`. pkg filename: `qprof-meta-llama-2-13b-awq-v1.2.0.qpkg`. semver rules: bump MAJOR for incompatible runtime/kernel expectations, MINOR for measurable accuracy/perf changes, PATCH for metadata fixes.

ben.quant: also include fields: `eval_set` (list), `anchor_baseline` (hash/name), and `delta_metrics` (list of {metric,delta}). that lets Optimize show sortable columns.

profile-bot: CI results uploaded: `qprof-meta-llama-2-13b-awq-v1.2.0.qpkg` passed perf/regression checks. mmlu:-0.9%, truthfulqa:-1.1%, end2end-latency: -34% at 128.

omar: fallback heuristics: 1) exact model+quant+major version match 2) same model+quant lower minor (if kernel compatible flag true) 3) same architecture generic profile (e.g. `qlite-arch-13b-latency-v1`) 4) system default quant config. we should encode compatibility as a matrix in the manifest.

kai.eng: manifest sketch (example):
```json
{
  "model": "meta-llama-2-13b",
  "quant": "awq",
  "version": "1.2.0",
  "anchor_baseline": "float-1.0.0",
  "delta_metrics": "mmlu:-0.9,truthfulqa:-1.1",
  "seq_lens": "32,128,512",
  "kernels": "fused-gemm-v2,awq-kernel-64",
  "deploy_profile": "latency-1",
  "compatibility": "kernel_abi:v2"
}
```

liz.pm: need an authorization + provenance field too so Enterprise customers can audit who produced the qprof and which commit it came from. add `artifact_sig` and `source_commit`.

ben.quant: agree. also recommend an `evaluation_stamp` with seed/replicate counts so we don't overfit to a single run.

sara.ml: action items: 1) kai to draft the qpkg manifest schema PR (include semver rules & compatibility matrix) 2) ben to publish a short results doc with anchors and recommended default mappings to deployment profiles 3) liz to prototype UI columns + tooltip text 4) omar to add kernel variant support to runtime lookup. I'll own the naming guide doc. :thumbsup:

profile-bot: noted. created ticket OPT-381 for qprof packaging schema.
